name: Stabilized Ochre Jelly OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-06: Signal from the Electric Laboratory

generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: A ochre jelly can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

defensiveAbilities.name: Splorch
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An adjacent creature hits the ochre jelly with a Strike that would deal slashing or piercing damage

Effect A gout of acidic jelly shoots out at the attacker. The attacker must attempt a DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The attacker is unaffected.

Success The attacker takes 1d6 Acid Damage damage.

Failure The attacker takes 2d6 Acid Damage damage.

Critical Failure The attacker takes 2d6 Acid Damage damage and 2 Persistent,acid Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ochre Acid
offensiveAbilities.description: An ochre jelly's acid damages only flesh-not bone, stone, wood, or other materials.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
